# hivemind_forager_environment (Resource)

A Forager sandbox environment. Destroying it archives the environment unless `hard_delete` is true.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "base_image" {
  type        = string
  description = "Base image ID available in your HiveMind deployment."
}

resource "hivemind_forager_environment" "example" {
  name           = "example"
  base_image     = var.base_image
  setup_script   = "echo Ready"
  startup_mode   = "on_demand"
  docker_enabled = false
  # Destroy archives this environment by default.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_image` (String) Base image ID available in the HiveMind deployment.
- `name` (String) Environment display name.
- `setup_script` (String) Shell script run when baking the environment. Stored in state; reference sandbox secrets instead of embedding credentials.

### Optional

- `auto_detect_egress` (Boolean) Sparkbox only. Record DNS lookups during the next bake and merge them into `egress_allowlist`. The server clears the flag after a successful bake; Terraform keeps the configured value and only sends it on create or when it changes. Unset uses the server default (on for Sparkbox environments created without an allowlist).
- `cpu` (Number) vCPUs (1-12).
- `default_harness` (String) Default agent harness: `claude_code` (default) or `codex`.
- `description` (String) Environment description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `disk_gib` (Number) Disk in GiB (25-128).
- `docker_enabled` (Boolean) Enable Docker in the sandbox. Defaults to false.
- `egress_allowlist` (List of String) Allowed egress domains. Leave unset to keep whatever the server holds, including domains merged in by `auto_detect_egress`.
- `env_secrets` (Map of String) Map of sandbox env var name to sandbox-provider secret name.
- `hard_delete` (Boolean) Delete instead of archive on destroy.
- `integrations` (List of String) Service integrations to attach. Null inherits the org's default integrations.
- `memory_gib` (Number) Memory in GiB (2-32).
- `rebake_interval_min` (Number) Interval between scheduled rebakes, in minutes. Defaults to 1440.
- `repo` (String) `owner/repo` cloned into the sandbox.
- `sandbox_provider` (String) Sandbox runtime name. Defaults to the organization default. Changing an explicitly configured runtime replaces the environment.
- `size` (String) Named size preset. Leave unset to use `cpu`/`memory_gib`/`disk_gib` or the server default.
- `startup_mode` (String) Startup mode: `eager` (default) or `on_demand`.
- `validate_script` (String) Shell script used to validate the environment. Stored in state.
- `warm_script` (String) Shell script run when warming the environment. Stored in state.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String) Server revision timestamp used to detect concurrent updates.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace the UUID with the environment ID.
terraform import hivemind_forager_environment.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
